mutations.name: degeneracy_offset
mutations.description: Add a non-zero constant offset to the steered output so that beta=0 (the no-op setting) no longer reproduces the baseline. The degeneracy test must catch this.

mutations.name: half_strength_projection
mutations.description: Scale the projection matrix by 0.5, so with strength=2 the controller applies (I - 1*s s^T) instead of the Householder reflection (I - 2 s s^T). This does NOT preserve ||c|| and breaks Eq.6.

mutations.name: disable_intermediate_clipping
mutations.description: Make the Eq.7 clip a no-op so negative-projection patches are also steered, breaking the clipping invariant.

mutations.name: constant_mode_sign_flip
mutations.description: Flip the sign of the Eq.4 constant-alpha update so c_new = c + alpha*s instead of c - alpha*s, breaking the constant-mode arm.

mutations.name: no_ok_on_empty_disabled
mutations.description: Make _list_images return [] instead of raising on an empty directory, so metrics silently report on zero images (the no-OK-on-empty failure mode).
mutations.find:
if not imgs:
        raise ValueError(f"no images found in {directory} (no OK-on-empty)")
mutations.replace:
if not imgs:
        return []  # MUTATION no_ok_on_empty_disabled

mutations.name: imagenet_first_class_skipped

with open(p, "r") as f:

mutations.name: nudenet_count_all_classes
mutations.description: Remove the 8-exposed-class filter so nudity_total counts every detection >=0.6 over ALL NudeNet classes (faces, *_COVERED), inflating the total and falsely refuting the nudity claims (review F1). The filter test must catch this.
mutations.replace: if d.get("score", 0.0) >= threshold:  # MUTATION nudenet_count_all_classes (filter removed)

mutations.name: renormalize_multiconcept_mean_at_steer
mutations.description: Re-normalize the steering vector b to unit L2 at steer time (the pre-F3/A3 behavior), so the Eq.9 multi-concept sub-unit mean is replaced by its unit direction -- multiplying effective suppression by ~1/||mean|| and contradicting the paper's 'simply averaging' (review A3 / SPEC U9). The no-renormalization test must catch this.
mutations.find:
vector_reshaped = vector.to(self.device).reshape(-1, num_heads, hidden_dim).transpose(0, 1)
        b_reshaped = b.unsqueeze(-1)
mutations.replace:
vector_reshaped = vector.to(self.device).reshape(-1, num_heads, hidden_dim).transpose(0, 1)
        b = b / torch.linalg.norm(b, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=EPS)  # MUTATION renormalize_multiconcept_mean_at_steer
        b_reshaped = b.unsqueeze(-1)

mutations.name: snoopy_task_uses_nudity_vector
mutations.description: Make the snoopy task load the nudity vector instead of the Snoopy vector (the pre-F3 behavior), so the snoopy/style runs are steered with the wrong concept and the wrong quantity is measured (review F3). The per-task-vector test must catch this.

note: A suite nobody has broken on purpose is not evidence. Each mutation is a deliberately inserted defect; the named must_fail test node currently PASSES and must FAIL when the find->replace is applied. covers lists the aspects the mutation exercises; the set covers core, degeneracy, eval and data.
